Title: Public Preview: Workspaces in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
Workspaces for Azure API Management is now in public preview. This new capability enables granular access control in multi-team Azure API Management deployments. API Management platform owners can separate team permissions for managing APIs by scoping them to a workspace.

With this new functionality, organizations can now:

Enable central platform team to maintain the platform infrastructure  
Have the decentralized API teams independently manage and publish APIs in their own workspace, without access to other teams’ workspaces.

Read documentation here.
